Stages of filter_care_setting()

Source: R/utils-filter.R
apply_type_correction.Rd

Internal helpers that filter_care_setting() runs in order, so the exported function reads as a short pipeline.

Usage

apply_type_correction(data, type_col_str, mask, fix_to)

resolve_facility_id_str(
  id_col_sym,
  fix_facility_id_vector,
  verbose,
  call = rlang::caller_env()
)

correct_by_facility_id(
  data,
  fac_col_str,
  type_col_str,
  id_col_str,
  fix_facility_id_vector,
  fix_to
)

correct_by_facility_name(
  data,
  fac_col_str,
  type_col_str,
  fix_facility_type_vector,
  fix_to,
  dry_run
)

correct_by_facility_regex(
  data,
  fac_col_str,
  type_col_str,
  fix_facility_type_regex,
  already_corrected,
  fix_to
)

preview_type_corrections(
  data,
  fac_col_str,
  type_col_str,
  id_col_str,
  use_facility_id,
  keep_types
)

inform_dropped_types(data, type_col_str, keep_types, verbose)

warn_if_no_rows(result, keep_types)

Arguments

data

A data frame already passed through clean_names_safe(), with the .original_facility_type column added.

type_col_str, fac_col_str, id_col_str

Names of the facility type, facility, and facility ID columns in data.

mask

Logical vector, one element per row: which rows to correct.

fix_to

The facility type value to write.

id_col_sym

The symbol returned by resolve_col_optional() for the facility ID column, or NULL when it is absent.

fix_facility_id_vector, fix_facility_type_vector

Values selecting the facilities to correct by ID and by exact name, or NULL.

verbose

Logical. Whether to emit informational messages.

call

The environment errors are attributed to; see resolve_col().

dry_run

Logical. Whether the call is a preview.

fix_facility_type_regex

A single regular expression, or NULL.

already_corrected

Facility names already corrected by an earlier route, which the regex route skips.

use_facility_id

Logical. Whether the ID column is present, so it is included in the preview.

keep_types

Character vector of facility types to keep.

result

The filtered data frame.

Value

resolve_facility_id_str() returns a string. correct_by_facility_id() returns a list with the corrected data and the names of the facilities it corrected. The other correct_by_*() functions and apply_type_correction() return the corrected data frame. preview_type_corrections() returns the preview tibble. inform_dropped_types() and warn_if_no_rows() are called for their conditions.

Details

The stages, in the order filter_care_setting() calls them:

  1. resolve_facility_id_str() returns the facility ID column name, or NA_character_ when the (optional) column is absent. It aborts if fix_facility_id_vector was supplied but the column is absent, and otherwise informs that ID-based corrections are unavailable.

  2. correct_by_facility_id(), correct_by_facility_name(), and correct_by_facility_regex() overwrite the facility type with fix_to for the facilities each route selects. They run in that order; the regex route skips every facility an earlier route already corrected, so the three routes combine without double-correcting.

  3. preview_type_corrections() builds the dry_run preview.

  4. inform_dropped_types() and warn_if_no_rows() report what the keep_types filter excluded.

apply_type_correction() is the shared primitive behind the three correction routes: it overwrites the facility type column with fix_to for the rows selected by mask, leaving other rows unchanged.
